## createNodeHost() function

Create a Node.js host platform for the WASM module.

Uses the standard vaultkeeper config directory: - macOS/Linux: `~/.config/vaultkeeper` - Windows: `%APPDATA%/vaultkeeper`

Override with `VAULTKEEPER_CONFIG_DIR` environment variable.
